SELECT
    p.id AS proposal_id,
    p.customer_id,
    p.field_name,
    p.current_value,
    p.proposed_value,
    c.hubspot_contact_id
FROM contact_change_proposals p
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.status = 'approved'
  AND c.hubspot_contact_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH changed AS (
    UPDATE contact_change_proposals p
    SET
        status = 'applied',
        applied_at = NOW()
    WHERE p.id = $1::bigint
      AND p.customer_id = $2::bigint
      AND p.status = 'approved'
      AND p.field_name = $3::text
      AND p.proposed_value = $4::text
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM customers c
          WHERE c.id = p.customer_id
            AND c.hubspot_contact_id = $5::text
            AND (
                (p.field_name = 'phone'
                    AND c.phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.current_value)
                OR
                (p.field_name = 'company'
                    AND c.company IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.current_value)
            )
      )
    RETURNING p.*
),

updated_customer AS (
    UPDATE customers c
    SET
        phone = CASE
            WHEN changed.field_name = 'phone'
            THEN changed.proposed_value
            ELSE c.phone
        END,
        company = CASE
            WHEN changed.field_name = 'company'
            THEN changed.proposed_value
            ELSE c.company
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM changed
    WHERE c.id = changed.customer_id
    RETURNING c.id
),

logged AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_audit_logs (
        customer_id,
        action,
        outcome,
        details
    )
    SELECT
        changed.customer_id,
        'hubspot_field_update',
        'applied',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'field', changed.field_name,
            'previous', changed.current_value,
            'new', changed.proposed_value,
            'hubspot_id', $5::text
        )
    FROM changed
    JOIN updated_customer c
      ON c.id = changed.customer_id
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM changed) AS applied_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logged) AS audit_count;

WITH changed AS (
    UPDATE contact_change_proposals
    SET status = 'conflict'
    WHERE id = $1::bigint
      AND status = 'approved'
    RETURNING customer_id, field_name,
              current_value, proposed_value
),
logged AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_audit_logs (
        customer_id, action, outcome, details
    )
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        'hubspot_field_update',
        'conflict',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'field', field_name,
            'baseline', current_value,
            'proposed', proposed_value,
            'hubspot_current', $2::text
        )
    FROM changed
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS conflicts_recorded
FROM logged;
